name: Enthenium
description: Enthenium was a jungle planet located in the Enthenium system in the Jjannex sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated in grid square K-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid along the Lipsec Run in the Western Reaches. A Separatist base was located on the planet.
